summary: GOS-98 | Login | data-persistence | A fresh login after Logout starts clean and shows the Dashboard with the admin image
title: A fresh login after Logout starts clean and shows the Dashboard with the admin image
preconditions: The build with the profile menu is deployed [TO BE CONFIRMED: check on build]
A dedicated test admin account exists ([VALID_ADMIN_USERNAME] / [VALID_ADMIN_PASSWORD])
The admin logged in without Remember Me and the Dashboard is open
This case uses its own login session, not the shared admin_storage_state

steps.expected: The login page is shown with empty Username and Password
The login page is still shown; both fields are still empty; no username or password is stored in the form

steps.action: Log in again with the same account
steps.expected: The Dashboard opens
The admin image (admin-avatar) is visible and the popup (admin-menu) is closed

tier_reason: Confirms Logout leaves nothing behind and a new session works
automation_rationale: Needs its own login (GAP-CR003-04) and a second login, which adds site hits; run only on an agreed test environment
notes: Does not check the server session via old cookie or direct URL (out of scope; AMB-CR003-08).
